params.body:
The second pass at verdicts that open a task nobody can act on. After #251 the fleet carries 62 tasks; about twenty of them come from four rules that fire on something with no hand, no owner, or no stable reading. Each change is a level or a registry entry; the facts stay on the cards.

## What changes

**CSP_MISSING becomes background.** Eight sites carry it. No playbook writes a policy, and one cannot be guessed from outside: it needs a per-site list of everything the page loads. As a month task it can only sit there, on every site, every week. HSTS (`HEADERS_HEAVY_MISSING`) stays a task because the headers hand can set it.

**Lab vitals: needs improvement becomes background.** `LCP_FAIR`, `SCORE_FAIR`, `INP_FAIR` and `CLS_FAIR` are lab numbers from one run, and one run swings across the middle boundary from round to round (on 2026-11-11: trustedagentic scored 65, afrodidact painted in 3.1 s, the Observatory in 2.9 s with a score of 95). Poor stays the week task, because poor is far enough past the line that one run does not cross it by chance. `PAGE_HEAVY` and `SAVINGS_LARGE` keep their month level.

`follows` still behaves. `linkCauses` only folds into a parent at the same urgency or worse, so a month child under a background parent stays its own task and does not vanish with a parent Portal shows no task for. A new test covers this (`test_a_task_never_folds_into_a_background_parent`).

**ERRORS_SOME needs ten errors.** One failed outside call at midnight was a month task (Naviskore, one "Error Fetching http headers"). A new `ERRORS_FEW` (1 to 9, background) keeps the count visible on the card; `ERRORS_SOME` starts at 10; `ERRORS_MANY` is unchanged.

**Mail authentication is not judged on a platform's domain.** For `glk-transferor.on-forge.com` the apex is `on-forge.com`, so the SPF and DMARC tasks were about Forge's records. `Dns::PLATFORM_DOMAINS` lists the hosting platforms that give a site a name under their own domain (Forge, Laravel Cloud, Ploi, Netlify, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages and Workers, Heroku, Render, Fly, GitHub Pages, Firebase, Azure, Railway). On such a host the mail facts are left out instead of set to 0, so the mail facets are not judged at all, the drafts are not offered, and the records dropping out of the reading is not reported as a DNS change. The address records are still measured. The list is names, not a judgement, so it sits in the scan rather than in the registry.

## Left out: one refused credential, four tasks

Today the Observatory has `credentials:keys` (`CREDENTIAL_REFUSED`, the claude a1 OAuth login expired), and from the same cause `app:queue` (153 failed), `app:errors` (67) and `app:collection` (`ADAPTERS_OVERDUE`). `follows` works within one measurement, and Portal folds per block, so these stay four tasks.

A clean next step: the app already declares its credentials in `extra.credentials` with the refusal it saw. AppHealth could carry the names of refused credentials as a fact (`refusedCredentials`), and a verdict on queue, errors or collection could then point at the credentials measurement as its cause (`follows: 'credentials:CREDENTIAL_REFUSED'`). Portal would fold across blocks on that address. This touches the verdict contract and Portal's folding, so it belongs in its own pair of PRs, not in a level change.

## Expected effect on today's fleet

- `exposure:csp` on abovebeyond, afrodidact-website, cafe-t-hoekske-website, garage-de-backer-website, kubo-it-lab, menukaart-webapp, portal and sportbusinessgame.
- `vitals:lcp` on afrodidact-website (3.1 s), gentells (3.8 s) and signal-observatory-gentells (2.9 s); `vitals:score` on trustedagentic (65).
- `app:errors` on naviskore-webapp (1) and stocklistplatform-eu (1).
- `dns:spf` and `dns:dmarc` on glk-transferor.

## Tests

The full suite passes (766 tests), and Pint and PHPStan are clean. The existing tests that asserted the old levels were updated, and new tests cover the background parent, the error minimum and platform hosts.
params.title: Stop raising tasks no one can pick up: CSP, lab vitals, single errors, mail on platform hosts
